text:
sam: Customer (Acme) reports streaming responses getting cut off mid-chunk, then client reconnects and gets 504s. They're seeing a big retry/billing spike. Attach: short capture + request-id.
liam: Can you paste the minimal repro (curl) and the request-id? Any LB/proxy in front of us?
sam: repro I gave them: `curl -v -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-large\"`
sam: customer logs show stream stopped after ~58s, socket closed, then client retried immediately ~30 times.
ingress-bot: ALB target-group idle_timeout_seconds=60 (last change 2025-07-01T14:12:02Z)
kevin: That ALB idle timeout = 60s is suspicious. If the origin only pushes data infrequently (heartbeats >60s) ALB will close the connection. Also nginx/proxies in front may buffer if not configured for chunked SSE. Cloudflare can also hold connection and drop on inactivity.
liam: Quick checklist: 1) is origin sending keepalives (":\n\n" or `:\n\n` SSE ping) at <= interval, 2) proxy buffer off (nginx: `proxy_buffering off;`), 3) proxy_read_timeout > expected idle window, 4) ALB idle timeout >= heartbeat interval + margin.
maria: FYI billing: customer retried 30-60x per minute during incident window -> noticeable invoice delta. They want mitigation ASAP.
kevin: Minimal server-side fix we can recommend immediately: send an SSE comment/heartbeat every 15s. Example server chunk: `\n: heartbeat\n\n` or `data: \"_\"\n\n` (keeps buffers flushed). Also ensure responses use `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and not buffered by upstream.
sam: Sent these to customer; they asked for specific nginx/ALB configs. Pasted snippet:
```
# nginx origin proxy settings
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection '';
  proxy_read_timeout 600s;
  proxy_send_timeout 600s;
  add_header X-Accel-Buffering no;
}
```
kevin: For ALB we recommend idle_timeout >= 300s for streaming-heavy flows. For NLB use TCP-level keepalive tweaks. For Cloudflare, set `origin_keepalive` and consider bypassing certain proxies for long-lived SSE endpoints.
liam: Repro tip we used locally: run `socat -d -d TCP-LISTEN:8080,reuseaddr,fork EXEC:\"(sleep 70; printf 'data: hi\n\n')\"` then curl -N; with ALB idle 60s the connection drops before the data arrives.
kevin: Also add server-side instrumentation: emit a special header `X-Stream-Heartbeat-Interval` in responses and require client to send `X-Request-ID` on connect so we can correlate traces quickly.
sam: Customer tried increasing ALB idle to 300s and adding heartbeat; confirmed stream now stays alive and retries stopped. They still want permanent mitigation rolled out on our side (server heartbeat + docs + default infra guidance).
maria: I'll flag billing mitigation: credit request pending while eng confirms root cause.
liam: Action items: 1) eng-runtime to add optional server heartbeat for SSE endpoints (kevin), 2) docs/devex to add streaming proxy checklist (liam), 3) infra to audit ALB default idle timeout for streaming customers (create ticket), 4) support to send interim credit and workaround notes to Acme (sam).
kevin: Proposed runbook snippet for ops ticket:
```
- Verify `proxy_buffering off` / `X-Accel-Buffering: no` on ingress
- Set `proxy_read_timeout` >= 600s for SSE routes
- Ensure ALB idle_timeout_seconds >= 300 for streaming target groups
- If Cloudflare in front: set appropriate origin timeout / disable buffering for SSE
- Add heartbeat every 15s from server when idle > 10s
- Log X-Request-ID and heartbeat events for easy triage
```
sam: Marking customer case: workaround applied + billing credit being discussed. Will follow up when eng has a timeline for built-in heartbeat and docs. :thumbsup:
